description: Proposed by the backend for review by the schema owner. Evaluator-only truth data: never served to agents.
title: boundary_state (hidden, evaluator-only)

downstream_factor.description: f_d, the clipped factor that multiplies the boundary-law coefficient (decision D23); with profile v2 it is the regime value times the clipped OU factor, between 0.6 and 10 (decision D73)

log_downstream_factor.description: the unclipped Ornstein-Uhlenbeck state, log f_d

boundary_law_coefficient_m.description: c f_d in m (pressure basis: head)

demand_regime_value.description: Profile v2 only: the regime value of the downstream factor before the OU factor (decision D73)

receipt_setpoint_nominal_m3h.description: Profile v2 only: the commanded receipt set-point

receipt_setpoint_effective_m3h.description: Profile v2 only: the set-point the controller follows, the nominal value with the clipped deviation (decision D73)
